heading: From prompt to PR in three steps.
description: Helix takes a single goal and turns it into a stream of small, verified, mergeable changes — without you babysitting an agent for hours.

steps.title: Describe the goal
steps.description: Tell Helix what you want — a feature, a refactor, a bug fix — in plain language. It reads your repo, asks clarifying questions, and locks down an acceptance criteria.
bullets: Natural-language intent, no DSL to learn
Repo is read first so suggestions match your stack
Acceptance criteria agreed before any code is written

steps.title: Decompose & orchestrate
steps.description: Helix decomposes the goal into atomic cards, then fans them out to parallel agents. Independent atoms run in parallel; dependent ones wait on their inputs.
bullets: Each atom has explicit inputs, outputs, and a test plan
Dependency graph runs independent units in parallel
Every atom is verified against the live repo before merging

steps.title: Review & ship
steps.description: You get one small, focused PR per atom — with the prompt that produced it, the verification log, and a replay link. Approve, request changes, or let Helix iterate.
bullets: Small reviewable diffs instead of one sprawling change
Auditable trail: prompt → atom → verification → PR
Replayable runs so any merge can be reproduced or rolled back
